image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a dark, textured rock surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and stripes. Its head is turned slightly to the left, showing a prominent eye and parotoid gland area. The skin appears wet and reflective. There is faint, illegible text or watermark in the bottom left corner.
